item.text:
It provides shop-order helpers: calculate totals, apply percentage codes, compute an item-price average, and format an order.

Bugs:
- `calcTotal` loops with `i <= items.length` ([test/orders.js](/C:/Users/Kerim/AppData/Local/Temp/codex-eco-bench-KlkLMw/test/orders.js:5)), so it accesses `items[items.length]` and crashes on `.price`; use `<`.
- `averageItemPrice` divides the quantity-weighted order total by number of line items ([test/orders.js](/C:/Users/Kerim/AppData/Local/Temp/codex-eco-bench-KlkLMw/test/orders.js:21)); that is not an average unit price when quantities vary.
- An empty item list should be handled explicitly; otherwise the average is invalid (and currently crashes via `calcTotal`).
